name: frBTC Wrap/Unwrap Flow Tracing
summary: Trace a chain of frBTC wrap/swap/unwrap/dispatch transactions to compute net BTC flow, expected vs actual payouts, and flag undisclosed fees.
whenToUse: Use when auditing a Bitcoin address's wdsx7/frBTC/Alkanes transaction history to verify wrap fees, deferred dispatch payouts, and whether stated 'no fee' claims hold up against on-chain data.
inputs: Per-TX inputs/outputs with BTC and frBTC amounts
Any protocol fee claims to verify
outputs: Cost breakdown by category (miner fees, AMM slippage, dust, residual)

name: BTCfi Hype vs Real Rubric
summary: Classify a BTCfi claim, protocol, or narrative as Real, Hype, or Mixed using a checklist derived from BTCfi's history (trust/custody, valuation-vs-mechanism, adversarial testing, indexer fragility).
whenToUse: Use when asked whether a new Bitcoin-DeFi project, yield narrative, or 'trustless' bridge claim is substantive infrastructure or speculative froth.
inputs: Description of the BTCfi protocol/claim/narrative to evaluate
Any stated valuations, TVL, or yield figures
outputs: Answers to the four checks (trust/custody, valuation-vs-mechanism, adversarial/scale test, indexer fragility)
Verdict: Real / Hype / Mixed, with what's-real and what's-hype lines
